description.en: Iterates over feature_order from the build plan and runs the installed workflow "SaaS — Implement One Feature" (pool entry saas-feature-implement) once per feature, each as its own run. Context: feature_order_json (JSON list of feature ids or {id, desc} objects), slug, stack and feature_workflow_id — the id of that installed workflow. Requires a SaaS factory in the project (directory saas-factory/ or FACTORY_ROOT with the CLI tools/factory); it is not part of this repository.
description.de: Iteriert über feature_order aus dem Build-Plan und startet je Feature den installierten Workflow „SaaS — Feature implementieren“ (Pool-Eintrag saas-feature-implement) als eigenen Lauf. Kontext: feature_order_json (JSON-Liste aus Feature-IDs oder {id, desc}-Objekten), slug, stack und feature_workflow_id – die ID dieses installierten Workflows. Voraussetzung: eine SaaS-Factory im Projekt (Verzeichnis saas-factory/ oder FACTORY_ROOT mit der CLI tools/factory); sie gehört nicht zu diesem Repository.

author: MySuricates
instructions: Works through the planned features in order, one separate run of saas-feature-implement per feature. After three failed features in a row the loop stops (max_consecutive_failures) – the TodoTrigger then assumes manual resolution.

config.items_command: printf '%s' {{ feature_order_json }} | python3 -c 'import json,sys; [print(json.dumps(f if isinstance(f, dict) else {"id": f, "desc": f})) for f in json.load(sys.stdin)]'
